verse.verse_1: Proclaim the Purity of your Lord, the Supreme.
verse.verse_2: The One Who created, and then made proper.
verse.verse_3: And the One Who kept proper measure and then guided.
verse.verse_5: Then made it dry and dark.
verse.verse_6: We shall now make you read (O dear Prophet Mohammed – peace and blessings be upon him), so you will not forget.
verse.verse_7: Except what Allah wills; indeed He knows all the evident and all the concealed.
verse.verse_8: And We shall create the means of ease for you.
verse.verse_9: Therefore advise, if advising is beneficial.
verse.verse_10: Soon whoever fears will heed advice.
verse.verse_11: And the most wicked will stay away from it.
verse.verse_12: The one who will enter the biggest fire.
verse.verse_13: Then he neither dies in it, nor lives.
verse.verse_14: Indeed successful is the one who became pure.
verse.verse_15: And who mentioned the name of his Lord, then offered prayer.
verse.verse_16: But rather you prefer the life of this world!
verse.verse_17: Whereas the Hereafter is better and everlasting.
verse.verse_18: Indeed this is in the former scriptures.
verse.verse_19: In the Books of Ibrahim and Moosa.
